main_limit: No calibrated no-analogy policy; validation and persistent failure memory remain weak
Strong retrieval-training coupling but not a full selection/rejection/reuse loop
Rich explicit pipeline but control rules are domain/task specific and memory does not learn
Controls answerability rather than transfer validity of coherent analogies
Post-retrieval reuse solved in controlled memory setting; retrieval and persistent learning held fixed
No autonomous source search, rejection, or persistent epistemic memory
